column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the South” renders “the Negev”; “the road to Atharim” is an uncertain word, which some render as “the way of the spies.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Red Sea” renders “Sea of Reeds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “fiery serpents” renders “seraph serpents” (also in verse 8, “fiery serpent” = “seraph”).
Close to the Hebrew; “Waheb in Suphah” is an obscure phrase in a fragment whose syntax is incomplete.
Close to the Hebrew; “By the lawgiver” renders “with the scepter” (or “ruler's staff”).
Close to the Hebrew; “the wasteland” renders “Jeshimon,” possibly a place name.
Close to the Hebrew; “was fortified” renders “was strong”; the Greek reads “Jazer” here.
Close to the Hebrew; the Hebrew of this verse is obscure, and its rendering is uncertain.
